quests.name: Fuel the Flame
quests.description: The campfire needs fuel. Collect Bone Embers from skeleton corpses scattered around the wasteland.

quests.name: First Blood
quests.description: The wasteland is crawling with skeletons. Put a few back in the ground where they belong.

quests.name: Warming Glow
quests.description: Keep the campfire burning strong. Add fuel to stoke the flames and earn its protective warmth.

quests.name: Bone Collector
quests.description: Bone Embers are valuable fuel. Gather a larger stockpile to keep the fires burning through the long nights.

quests.name: Skeleton Slayer
quests.description: Prove your worth as a warrior. The undead hordes won't clear themselves.

quests.name: The Burning Wastes
quests.description: Venture beyond the safety of the campfire. Seek out the lava pools that dot the wasteland - but mind your step.

quests.name: Veteran Hunter
quests.description: The skeletons grow stronger the further you venture from the campfire. Hunt the more powerful ones.

quests.name: Skull Seeker
quests.description: Ancient Skulls hold power from ages past. Find them among the remains of fallen champions.

quests.name: Wasteland Scavenger
quests.description: A true survivor never passes up useful materials. Amass a fortune in Bone Embers.

quests.name: Fire Keeper
quests.description: The campfire is our sanctuary. Keep it blazing bright to ward off the darkness.

quests.name: Ancient Ruins
quests.description: Rumors speak of ancient ruins at the edge of the wasteland. Find them, if you dare.

quests.name: Guardian Slayer
quests.description: The ruins are protected by powerful guardians - elite skeletons bound to defend their domain. Destroy them.

quests.name: Claim the Ruins
quests.description: The ruins contain an ancient hearth. Convert it to a new campfire to expand our territory.

quests.name: Guardian's Bane
quests.description: Become the terror of the ruins. No guardian shall stand before you.

quests.name: Lich's Secret
quests.description: Legend tells of a Lich who once ruled these lands. Find the Lich's Finger Bone - a rare artifact of immense power.
